messages.subject: Project Quartz - responding draft (v3)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Adam,

Our responding mark-up attached. As discussed on the call, we've restored the 125% liability cap and the 750k minimum annual royalty, and reverted the audit threshold to 5%. We understand from your call with Sarah that Caldera can live with these, so subject to your confirmation we'll move to an execution version.

Kind regards,
Elena

Elena Marchetti
